title: Stock market holiday on Monday 14 Sept 2026: On Ganesha Chaturthi, NSE, BSE to remain closed
text: Stock market holiday on Monday 14 Sept 2026: On Ganesha Chaturthi, NSE, BSE to remain closed. Stock market investros can check the list of stock market holidays by logging in at the BSE website — bseindia.com
